source: 2025 final regular-season point differentials / 17 games, equivalent to centered average scoring margin; Pro-Football-Reference standings cross-check
formula: 0.70 * (home 2025 average-margin strength - away 2025 average-margin strength) + 1.0 generic HFA; neutral Melbourne game uses 0 HFA
productionRule: This is the only independent spread line eligible for the historically validated 80/20 market blend. QB/current-personnel/expert/matchup layers remain audit/scenario layers unless separately proven incremental over this production architecture.
notes: 2025 league point differentials sum to zero, so no additional recentering is required.
No provisional external ranking, manual roster/coaching adjustment, position-matchup point or QB point is embedded in this structural line.
Those layers can still invalidate or contextualize a structural edge; they simply do not receive unvalidated point weight.
